note: `levels` IS THE PRIVILEGE LATTICE, AND ITS ORDER IS THE WHOLE OF IT. grant-weigh.js ranks a level by its INDEX here, so this array is what says read < write < admin. Reordering it to ["admin","read","write"] does not reorder a list, it redefines which grants outrank which — a prior `read` would then outrank a requested `admin`, and an auto-renewal could widen into admin. Nothing validates this array against anything, so it is a privilege decision written as a JSON ordering, and it is stated here because it does not look like one.
renewalNote: A renewal skips the human. It is bounded three ways, all in grant-weigh.js's findRenewal: the prior grant must have been decided by a PERSON (`decidedByKind: "human"`), it must be at the same level or higher and for the same hours or more, and it must be inside this window measured from ITS OWN grantedAt. Auto-renewals do not start a new window, so one approval cannot be chained into indefinite access.
